title: RepoEKU
description: Evidence-bearing, repo-local Empirical Knowledge Unit capturing concrete implementation mechanisms, source snippets, tests, keywords, facets, and historical provenance.

id.description: Unique Repo EKU Identifier (e.g. REKU-RIVER-001, REKU-BULLMQ-001)

repository.description: Repository identifier (e.g. river, bullmq, litequeue, asynq)

domain.description: Problem domain (e.g. Queue, Broker & Distributed Workflow Systems)

substrate.description: Explicit underlying storage engine or execution substrate

claim.description: Precise mechanical statement of what this repository mechanism guarantees or requires

mechanism.description: Concrete technical mechanism name (e.g. Relational Lock-Free Dequeue, Atomic Lua Lock Deletion)

commonKeywords.description: Shared cross-cutting keywords common across similar queue mechanisms across repos

uniqueKeywords.description: Unique keywords that preserve repo-specific implementation and substrate nuances

keywordFacets.description: Structured multi-dimensional taxonomy facets across standardized architectural dimensions

applicabilityConditions.description: Substrate, runtime, and environment constraints under which this mechanism holds

localContext.description: Architectural explanation of why this mechanism exists and how it operates in this specific repository

evidenceIds.description: Down-traceable atomic observation (OBS-*) and historical failure (HIST-*) IDs

linkedDomainEkus.description: Domain-level EKUs supported by or connected to this Repo-Local EKU

linkedClaims.description: Domain-level Claims supported by or connected to this Repo-Local EKU

sourceProvenance.description: Source code location and verbatim snippet

abstractionLevel.description: Fixed abstraction tier for repo-local units

status.description: Lifecycle status of the knowledge unit
